name: Long Yuan Construction Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Long Yuan Construction Group Co., Ltd., founded in 1980 and based in Shanghai, China, operates as a comprehensive construction enterprise. The company's diverse activities span various sectors, including the development of residential complexes, educational facilities (such as universities and schools), medical centers, and sporting venues. Furthermore, they are proficient in constructing industrial plants, towering office buildings, and commercial or hospitality establishments. In addition to vertical construction, Long Yuan undertakes significant infrastructure projects, including the engineering of flyovers, roads, expressways, and bridges. Their specialized services extend to installing complex systems like air-conditioning equipment, various building layers, crucial pipeline and distribution substations for bus garages, and steel frameworks for airport terminals. The company also provides extensive finishing and decorative services for a wide array of properties, from luxury mansions, airports, and government buildings to hotels, academic exchange centers, R&D facilities, and indoor skiing sites. Complementing these offerings, they are adept at foundation works, landscape design, and the installation of modern curtain wall systems.
